say:2:1230423002:1.text: I passed through the village just the other day. The villagers are kind-hearted folks who are friendly and generous. I admire them!
say:2:1230423002:1.source_cn: 我前几天刚路过了小水村，那里的村民豪爽又大方，都是热心...
